goal: Clarify the differences between two common beverages in a dietary context without inducing anxiety.

canvas.split_line: Vertical cut of a cup in the middle seam, left oat milk color #D8C1A0, right milky white #F5F5F0, middle seam has fine line + small 'VS' round logo

header.main_title: Oat milk vs. cow's milk: Don't choose blindly across 7 dimensions
header.subtitle: Lactose intolerant / eco-friendly / fat control / fitness protein needs—check the chart first before deciding which to stock up on.

columns.name: Oat milk (fortified with calcium and vitamins)
columns.header_visual: Side view sketch of a paper box with a straw + oat grain outline
columns.tagline: Plants, mostly lactose-free (note the production line), coffee-friendly.

columns.name: Whole milk (pasteurized/high temperature sterilization)
columns.header_visual: Curved glass baby bottle + simple sketch of a little cow
columns.tagline: Complete protein, natural calcium, fat-soluble vitamin carrier

comparison_rows.count: Fluorescent blue-purple gradient background steals the spotlight.
comparison_rows.structure: Central column dimensions + left-right comparison, can use ✓/△/– with a light color background.
items: Calcium and D fortified (read ingredient list).
Saturated fats and total calories (per 250mL indicative level)
Subjective differences in blood sugar/satiety (not to be taken as a medical conclusion)
Unit price and availability (convenience store commonality)
Environmental footprint (qualitative assessment in water/soil/atmospheric aspects)
Coffee latte art / tea latte adapted (foam texture)
comparison_rows.marker_style: Checkmark + triangle + short dash + light amber highlight 'need to sample'
comparison_rows.highlight_winner_per_row: true, not fixed on the same side winning, based on objective symbols

footer.verdict: prioritize milk for protein; when lactose intolerant or wanting a flavor switch, you can use oat milk + balanced diet. Check ingredient lists, don’t blindly trust packaging claims.

must_keep: Central column dimension names centered, each line the same height.
avoid: Use extreme slogans to deny any beverage
